part.text: Now I have all the schema info. Let me query for the constructor with most points at Monaco GP (1980-2010).

input.sql:
SELECT c.name, c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points
FROM constructorResults cr
JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitId = ci.circuitId
JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE ci.name = 'Circuit de Monaco'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 5
